assets.prompt: Create an original premium editorial illustration for a fictional invitation-only adult magical evening brand named Wand Night Stand. Portrait orientation 3:4. No text, no lettering, no people, no faces, no suitcase, no recognizable Harry Potter or other franchise motifs, no sexual imagery. A mysterious closed oxblood velvet curtain with a fine warm-brass crescent clasp, one slightly displaced fold suggesting anticipation, a single botanical night flower in the foreground on an ivory marble sill. Hand-painted gouache and fine lithographic shading, art-directed still life, refined theatrical intimacy, restrained surreal humor. Rich near-black plum background #211a22, oxblood #672e43, warm cream #f4ecd9 and antique gold #cfaa6c. Strong quiet negative space around the subject, beautiful tactile pigment, precise edges, high-end independent cultural magazine cover. Main subject contained in middle 75% with generous edges for responsive crop. This is a production onboarding/countdown placeholder, not a UI mockup. Deliver one image.

assets.prompt: One original editorial still life illustration, landscape 3:2, for Wand Night Stand magical evening keepsake archive. No text, no people, no faces, no franchise iconography, no Harry Potter props. A slender hand-carved dark wood theatrical wand with a simple brass ring and a dried night-blooming flower rests diagonally on warm ivory folded paper with an unmarked oxblood wax seal, lying on deep near-black plum velvet. Painterly refined gouache and lithograph detail, cultured witty independent arts publication, beautiful tactile paper edge. Palette warm paper #f4ecd9, oxblood #672e43, muted antique brass #cfaa6c, near-black plum #211a22. Quiet composition, natural asymmetry, generous empty space. This is production keepsake empty-state art. Not a UI screenshot.
